run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate a GIF from a trajectory file
run_parallelized_generation: run parallelize_generation to render POV-Ray images and create a GIF from a trajectory file using multiple processes
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms to render a single POV-Ray snapshot image from an ASE atoms object with surface and adsorbate separation
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines CLI arguments for traj-path, out-path, and num-workers
refactor_pov_from_atoms: refactor pov_from_atoms to customize the bounding box, rotation angle, or covalent radii for different visualization needs
